fusions.name: Hand in the Coals
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health: a red-hot thrust at a target up to 5 tiles away for 8 fire damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach, that sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spitting Tongues
fusions.desc: Looses 3 branching tongues of flame, each dealing 18 fire damage to the first enemy it meets within 7 tiles and 80% of that to everything within 3 tiles of the hit.

fusions.name: Brazier Guard
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Toasting Tines
fusions.desc: Conjures red-hot tines on your weapon: your weapon damage rises by 10%, every strike sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, and you have 8% fire resistance.
